page.layout: One column of running text, one printed page on the scan. Running head above the text, page number at the top right. A stray "&" sits alone at the lower right, below the last line.

main_text.p: Militum inanium,seu ocioforum nebulonum novam sectam in Lufitania institui, quæ & Christi militia subdolè dicebatur, ut Saracenis (ceu dicūt) resisterent: ac Templariorum bona, annuente Al-phonso Portugaliæ rege illis delegauit, quo liberi milites [?]ut illi militiæ vacarent. Duos Thomas in Papisti-cos sanctos retulit: unum Herefordensem episcopum Anglum, & alterum Aquinatem Dominicanum: atq; unum tertium, Ludouicum episcopum Tolo-sanum, Caroli quondam Siciliæ regis filium, Mino-ritam, à Nicolao quarto prius admissum, illis addidit. Ordinauit, ut ter in die tintinnabula pulsa-rentur, quo populus in genua flectens, salutationem angelicam D. virgini idololatricè recitaret. Creatis deinde in secunda ordinatione Cardinalibus, eos declarauit pertinaces hæreticos, qui affirmarent Christum & Apostolos nihil bilhabuisse proprij. Misit diplomata ad Academias publicas, ne scholastici ea de re disputare auderent. Damnauit præterea Petri cuiusdam Franciscani glossulam, qui ad Christi paupertatem [?]tandam quodam animum erat: quorum de numero multi damnati & exusti sunt. Habita insuper ordinatione tertia, decem Cardinales creauit: inter quos fuere Ioannes Columna, & Matthæus de gente Vrsina Dominicanus. Carmelitas [?]assumpsit in ius &

page.notes: The page is a single column; the stray "&" at the foot right is treated as a catchword. Page number read as 351 (printed "35ı"), doubtful. Running head "ACTIS LIBER VI" read as printed; the "Vi" may be "VI". Several words in the lower half are rough (ius, tintinnabula, the Franciscan's name and the Carmelite clause), so they are marked [?] or are uncertain. Long s is written as plain s throughout. The line break "no-/uam" is written whole as "novam" because the printed hyphen is faint. Words near the top left are partly damaged by staining and show-through, so some letters may be off.
